findings.title: Shim and Rust runtime path not tied by a test
findings.problem: runtime_base/runtime_dir (Library/Application Support/CodeMie/runtime/<key>, .complete marker) and assets/macos/bin/codemie (same path rebuilt by hand) are two independent definitions of one contract. Shim tests hand-copy the path string and no Rust test references the shim, so both suites stay green if either side changes.
findings.impact: The app could report ready and install while the user-facing `codemie` shim exits 1 'not set up yet'.
findings.recommendation: Add a test that promotes a fake runtime into runtime_dir(tmp_home) and runs the shim under HOME=tmp_home with a matching runtime-key, expecting the fake node to run.

findings.title: install() orchestration has no test
findings.problem: Only leaf helpers (verify_sha, unpack, promote, remove_stale) are tested. install() and the ensure_runtime failure cleanup are not run by any test. CODEMIE_RUNTIME_URL already allows a local server.
findings.impact: Removing or reordering the verify_sha call, hashing wrong bytes, skipping promote, or dropping the failure cleanup would ship tampered-archive acceptance or leftover partial state with all tests green.
findings.recommendation: Add a test against a local HTTP server: a wrong-checksum body returns Err and leaves no .download-/.staging- files; a correct body ends with is_ready(dir) true.

findings.title: Baked-pack test fails on non-macOS
findings.problem: the_baked_pack_is_complete is not cfg-gated, but off macOS PACK_JSON is the empty placeholder, so the assertions on a non-empty key, https url and 64-char sha fail.
findings.impact: cargo test fails on Windows, which the task says must not regress.
